title: Rav Tachlifa, Brother of Ravinai of Chozai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Beitzah 16b (15b–16a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.15b.21): he recited a baraita: “All of a person’s food is allotted to him from Rosh Hashanah,” etc.; Rabbi Abbahu said, “What is the verse?” etc. Hyman infers that he preceded Rabbi Abbahu. The [Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Beitzah.8b.1) and the [Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Beitzah.2.4.1) have a different reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Bavli names him at the end of 15b. The [baraita and Abbahu’s question](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.16a.1-2) follow on 16a. Hyman cites [16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.16b.12), which names a different figure in the linked edition, Tachlifa bar Avdimi.

The Rif gives Tachlifa as Ravnai’s father, with brother as an alternative. The Rosh reads “son of Ravnai’s father,” with brother as an alternative. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3218&lang=en) also cites the Rif. The chronological inference is Hyman’s.
